title: Seven Commander staples as a manual Oracle batch

provenance.oracleText: Entered by hand from the current Oracle wording, using modern self-reference templating, because Scryfall (api.scryfall.com and data.scryfall.io) was unreachable from the implementation environment (HTTPS CONNECT 403). It has not been compared with the pinned snapshot.
provenance.requiredVerification: Before release, compare every raw field (name, mana cost, types, subtypes, power/toughness, color identity, Oracle text) and the catalog metadata with the pinned Scryfall oracle_cards snapshot (bulk 27bf3214-1271-490b-bdfe-c0be6c23d02e, updated 2026-08-30T09:01:56.964+00:00, compressed SHA-256 a85e1309439fcaca2639b5eaf0cd2f71a0f4de8bd3926617fae3eded1dda5528). Record the Scryfall print IDs at the same time.
provenance.oracleIds: Copied from docs/catalog/remaining-cards.csv, which the catalog exporter generated from that snapshot.
provenance.scryfallIds: Not recorded (null). Without a Scryfall print ID the runtime cannot fetch these images and shows the card back for all seven cards. The snapshot-based provenance verifier (scripts/verify-oracle-batch-provenance.mjs) requires nonempty Scryfall IDs for manual rows, so it will fail until the IDs are filled in from the snapshot.
provenance.catalogMetadata: Type line, colors, color identity and Commander legality only. Set, set name, collector number, rarity, release date and Scryfall URI are unknown and omitted. Produced-mana fields for Mana Drain (C) and Urza, Lord High Artificer (U) were inferred from the rules text.
provenance.catalogExport: docs/catalog/imported-cards.csv, docs/catalog/remaining-cards.csv, docs/catalog/summary.json and docs/card-catalog.md were intentionally left unchanged because scripts/export-card-catalog.mjs requires the pinned snapshot. Until it is regenerated, that export still lists these seven cards as remaining and its counts and fingerprints predate this batch.

implementationNotes: Smothering Tithe and Esper Sentinel ask the paying opponent. A human or remote player always gets both choices; a local AI pays only when the tax is at most the value denied ({2} for a Treasure, {3} for a card) and, while developing on its own turn, still leaves two mana.
Esper Sentinel reads X on resolution and uses the creature's last known power if it has left the battlefield.

Orcish Bowmasters ignores only the first card an opponent draws during that opponent's own draw step. Amass Orcs 1 creates a 0/0 black Orc Army token when needed. If the single target becomes illegal, the whole ability does nothing.

Necropotence exiles the card face down with no one allowed to look at it and returns it at its controller's next end step. The engine does not offer life-cost abilities when the cost equals the player's whole life total, so Pay 1 life is unavailable at exactly 1 life.

Underworld Breach uses the engine's escape path, so escaped cards count as escaped and the three other cards are exiled after mana payment. Cards without a mana cost are not offered (unpayable cost). Split cards, Rooms and the back faces of double-faced cards are not offered; an adventurer card escapes only as its main card.

Mana Drain's mana arrives at the beginning of the caster's next main phase, including the postcombat main phase of the same turn, as colorless mana. An uncounterable target is still legal, so the mana is still added; a target that has left the Stack makes Mana Drain do nothing.

Urza's mana ability may tap any untapped artifact, including summoning-sick artifact creatures. The Construct uses the existing BRC Construct token art; the {5} permission lasts until end of turn and also allows a land play.

selectionPolicy.names: Seven popular Commander staples that were absent from the runtime and listed in docs/catalog/remaining-cards.csv.
